scope: Portable actors; not named persons or deployment personas

roles.label: Task recipient or relying party
roles.definition: A party expected to receive, act on or rely on a task addressed to a defined audience.
roles.applicability: contextual; may be individual or organizational

roles.label: Credential relying party
roles.definition: A party making a decision using credential evidence or associated task outcome evidence.
roles.applicability: contextual; may be individual or organizational
